text:
aaron (product): quick thread to align on 'onramp' deliverables for enterprise compliance pilots. customers asking for clear contractable acceptance tests for keystore/BYOK, audit export shape, and retention lanes.
deepa (eng): agree. propose a trimmed MVP: 1) cloud-KMS BYOK (no HSM attestation), 2) 90-day hot index with on-demand NDJSON export, 3) tenant retention flag + TTL job. avoid cold-archive in MVP.
riley (security): must log KMS metadata (key-id, region, attestation-ref if present) and include proof-of-rotation events. also require a minimal threat-model doc for pilot customers.
jamal (sales): Pilot asks from two prospects: MeridianBank wants HSM attestation and 7y retention; BrightHealth ok with cloud-KMS and 90d. Meridian is only willing to pilot with attestation; can we offer attestation via partner?
nina (custeng): BrightHealth wants fast forensic exports for recent traffic (<10m) and ability to run on-demand exports scoped to tenant/time-range. They can accept phased deliveries.
aaron (product): acceptance-test sketch: A) BYOK handshake: POST /v1/keystore/handshake -> returns key-ref; verify audit entry contains key-ref and handshake status. B) Export: GET /v1/audit/export?tenant=X&start=...&end=... -> returns NDJSON matching schema v1 and includes chain-of-custody headers. C) Retention toggle: POST /v1/tenant/X/retention {ttl: "7y"} -> after TTL job, confirm tombstone + export snapshot includes deletion marker.
deepa (eng): implementation notes: hot index for 90d needed for <10m queries; we'll keep retention metadata in tenant config. BYOK handshake will store only key-reference (no raw keys). exporting very wide ranges will be paginated and rate-limited. need cost estimate for 7y.
riley (security): for Meridian we can propose 'attestation-as-a-service' via PartnerHSM Inc. Security will draft integration doc and acceptance conditions (attestation token present in handshake audit). also need regression checks: synthetic requests must surface request-id, model-version, tenant-id, route, and kms-key-id.
legal-bot: created ticket COMP-9012 "Enterprise onramp: BYOK + audit export acceptance" assigned to product/eng/security.
jamal (sales): we should pre-bake contract language: acceptance = pass tests in staging + sample export reviewed by customer legal. can we commit to export latency SLOs?
aaron (product): SLOs: for 90d window exports up to 1h range -> complete within 30m for pilot; on-demand recent (<10m) sample -> <1min for single-page. we'll confirm with eng.
deepa (eng): can commit to <1min for recent single-page exports if they hit hot index. 30m for 1h ranges is optimistic but ok as pilot SLO; will add monitoring hooks.
riley (security): also propose encryption-at-rest proof and key-rotation report as part of acceptance.
aaron (product): next steps: deepa & riley produce tech-spec + regression harness by EOW; legal to draft contract clause and SLO language; jamal to prioritize Meridian vs BrightHealth for pilot. nina to onboard BrightHealth test dataset. keep MVP scope tight.
